title: First Trimester Nutrition Checklist: Folate, Iron, and Safer Foods
excerpt: Prioritize folic acid, iron-rich foods, hydration, and cooked foods during weeks 1-12
content:
## Introduction to First Trimester Nutrition

During the first trimester, nutrition plays a crucial role in the development of the fetus. Providing adequate essential nutrients will help the fetus develop healthily and reduce the risk of birth defects.

## Folate - A Crucial Nutrient

Folate is a crucial nutrient during pregnancy, especially during the first trimester. Folate helps prevent neural tube defects in the fetus. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), pregnant women should take 400 micrograms of folate daily. Foods rich in folate include leafy greens, fruits, whole grains, and dairy products.

## Iron - An Essential Nutrient

Iron is an essential nutrient during pregnancy, helping to prevent anemia and ensuring the fetus develops healthily. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), pregnant women should take 27 milligrams of iron daily. Foods rich in iron include red meat, poultry, fish, eggs, and legumes.

## Safer Foods During Pregnancy

During pregnancy, women should avoid foods with a high risk of food poisoning, such as:

* Raw or undercooked foods
* Foods containing listeria, such as soft cheese and deli meats
* Foods containing mercury, such as shark and swordfish

Instead, pregnant women should prioritize cooked foods, such as:

* Cooked vegetables
* Cooked meats
* Cooked fish

## Cooking Food Safely

To cook food safely, pregnant women should follow these steps:

* Wash hands thoroughly before cooking
* Wash food thoroughly before cooking
* Cook food to a safe internal temperature
* Store food at a safe temperature

## Conclusion

Nutrition during the first trimester plays a vital role in the development of the fetus. Pregnant women should prioritize essential nutrients, such as folate and iron, and avoid foods with a high risk of food poisoning. For more information on pregnancy nutrition, women can visit our [pregnancy meal planner](/planner) or join our [prenatal nutrition program](/premium).

## Note

Before making any changes to their diet, pregnant women should consult their doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure safety and effectiveness.

faqs.question: Why is folate important during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Folate helps prevent neural tube defects in the fetus

faqs.question: How can I cook food safely during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Cook food to a safe internal temperature and store food at a safe temperature

faqs.question: Can I get enough iron and folate from food alone?
faqs.answer: Yes, foods rich in iron and folate include red meat, poultry, fish, eggs, leafy greens, fruits, whole grains, and dairy products
